title: Jagged Light Venezuelan Pickle Casserole
description: A lacto-vegetarian friendly Venezuelan dish featuring dill pickles, this casserole is fermented, crumbly, and light, cooked to perfection in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot. It is a unique and delicious twist on traditional Venezuelan cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the ttukbaegi earthenware pot to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the cooked quinoa, black beans, shredded cheese, chopped cilantro, and sliced dill pickles.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Pour the lime juice mixture over the quinoa mixture and stir until everything is well combined.
Grease the preheated ttukbaegi earthenware pot with olive oil.
Add the quinoa mixture to the pot and smooth out the top.
Cover the pot with a lid and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
